definitions.explanation: The amount of mineral content in bones, used as a measure of bone strength. Low bone density is associated with osteoporosis and increased fracture risk.

A compound of {骨|こつ} (bone) and ⟦{密度|みつど}→密度：15137_mitsudo⟧ (density). A common health and medical term, especially relevant to discussions of aging, women's health, and {骨粗鬆症|こつそしょうしょう} (osteoporosis).
